suppress.notes: jackson-databind is a transitive dependency. Not directly referenced and cannot be upgraded independently without upstream dependency changes.
woodstox-core is a transitive dependency of the XML/Jackson stack (build tooling), not shipped in the release artifact.
Netty is a transitive framework dependency. The affected code paths are not reachable from this SDK and the version is pinned centrally via resolutionStrategy.
gRPC is a transitive dependency of the AWS/Amplify stack and is not shipped in the release artifact.
protobuf-java / protobuf-kotlin / protobuf-java-util are transitive dependencies and cannot be upgraded independently.
protobuf-kotlin is a transitive dependency and cannot be upgraded independently.
commons-compress is shaded inside Dokka build-tooling artifacts, not shipped in the release artifact.
FreeMarker is a transitive build-tooling dependency (dependency-check / Dokka reports), not shipped in the release artifact. The vulnerable path is not reachable in this project.
junit is a test-only dependency and is not shipped in the release artifact.
CVE-2020-29582 (temp-file permissions) and CVE-2026-53914 are reported against Kotlin stdlib/reflect and transitive Kotlin artifacts. Not reachable from this SDK's runtime surface.

CVE-2020-29582 and CVE-2026-53914 are incorrectly attributed to Dokka build-tooling artifacts (analysis-kotlin-descriptors, analysis-markdown, dokka-base, dokka-core), which are not shipped in the release artifact.
CVE-2008-7298 is a 2008 CVE for the old AOSP "Android Browser" app, incorrectly matched against the modern androidx.browser library.
